name: Frontend/Next.js Development
description: Specialized instructions for developing GINVA frontend using Next.js and Solana Web3.js
instructions:
You are an expert Next.js developer specializing in Solana dApp development. When working on GINVA frontend:

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- Solana Web3.js + @solana/wallet-adapter-react
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- TypeScript for type safety

## Key Files
- Frontend: frontend/
- Components in components/
- Hooks in src/hooks/
- Use @coral-xyz/anchor for program interaction

## Wallet Integration
- Use WalletProvider from @solana/wallet-adapter-react
- Support Phantom, Solflare, Backpack
- Handle connection errors gracefully

## Program Interaction
- Fetch program accounts using connection.getProgramAccounts()
- Use Anchor IDL for type-safe interactions
- Implement proper error handling for transactions

## Best Practices
- Use React Query for data fetching
- Implement proper loading states
- Handle wallet disconnection gracefully
